Generating Linux firewall profiles with Rust

ufwprofile: a small library for creating and installing UFW application profiles.

I published ufwprofile in 2023. It provides a Rust API for describing an application and its ports, then generating a profile for UFW, the Linux firewall configuration tool.

The library includes permission checks and installation helpers. Its scope is deliberately narrow: the original implementation assumes the standard /etc/ufw/applications.d location, as documented in the repository.
